title: Mapping Reality: The Transition to President and Sister Solancho
summary: With visa restrictions delaying the Listons, President Hughes announces that President and Sister Solancho have been called by the First Presidency as interim mission leaders starting June 30th. He uses this transition to reintroduce the concept of mental 'maps'—our internal worldviews—explaining that they are refined through either slow, painful experience or proactive observation of righteous leaders. Ultimately, he ties accurate map-building to an active 'input, process, output' framework driven by radical personal responsibility and situational awareness.
